summary: Limon Airport (LMH) is a small regional airfield serving the municipality of Limón in the Colón Department of Honduras, on the country's Caribbean coast. The airport supports general aviation and limited domestic flights, primarily connecting this remote area to other parts of Honduras. Its location near the Aguán Valley makes it a useful gateway for travelers visiting the coastal and agricultural regions of northern Honduras.
faqs:
Q: What type of airport is Limon Airport?
A: Limon Airport is a small regional airport serving general aviation and occasional domestic flights in northern Honduras.

Q: Which city does Limon Airport serve?
A: It serves the municipality of Limón in the Colón Department, located along Honduras's Caribbean coast.

Q: Are there commercial passenger flights at this airport?
A: Scheduled commercial service is limited or infrequent; travelers should verify current flight availability with local operators.

Q: Is Limon Airport near any major tourist destinations?
A: It provides access to the Caribbean coastline of Honduras and is within reach of the historic town of Trujillo and surrounding natural areas.
transport_tips: Ground transportation from Limon Airport is limited, so arranging a pickup with a local contact or pre-booked driver is advisable. Taxis and informal transport (mototaxis) are typically available at the airport and in the nearby town center. Renting a vehicle in advance is recommended if you plan to explore the broader Colón Department independently.
local_tip: Carry cash in small denominations, as ATMs are scarce in Limón and many local businesses do not accept cards.
